title: Integrality of the Lipschitz push-forward (parent Steps 4–8, Simon Lemma 3.9 core)
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P, V ⊆ ℝ^Q be open, T ∈ D_n(U) with T = τ(M,θ,ξ) for a triple with IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ and θ(x) ∈ ℕ for x ∈ M, f locally Lipschitz on U with f(U) ⊆ V and f⁻¹(K) ∩ spt T compact for every compact K ⊆ V, L : ℝ^P → L(ℝ^P, ℝ^Q) Hⁿ⌞M-a.e. strongly measurable such that for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M, t ↦ f(x + tv) has derivative L(x)v at 0 for every v in every weighted approximate tangent space of (M, θ) at x, and S ∈ D_n(V) with S(ω) = ∫_M θ(x)·(L(x)_#ξ(x))(ω(f(x))) dHⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(V). Then S is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (V : Set (Eucl Q)), IsOpen U → IsOpen V → ∀ (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) n) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q) (L : Eucl P → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl Q)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn V n), IsRectifiableTriple U n M θ ξ → (∀ x ∈ M, ∃ k : ℕ, θ x = k) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = tauAction n M θ ξ ω) → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → MapsTo f U V → (∀ K, IsCompact K → K ⊆ V → IsCompact (f ⁻¹' K ∩ T.support)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Tx : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M θ x Tx → ∀ v ∈ Tx, HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ => f (x + t • v)) (L x v) 0) → AEStronglyMeasurable L ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn V n, S ω = ∫ x in M, θ x * nVectorPushforward n (L x) (ξ x) ((ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl Q) n) (f x)) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P))) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S
